text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert fired via PagerDuty: HIGH packet loss detected in region az3 (us-east-3). Trigger: nic_rx_err_rate > 10% over 5m on nodes tagged pool=rgw-az3. Severity: P2. Alert link: https://pagerduty.example/alerts/PD-24683

PagerDuty: Auto-page: escalation step 1 -> oncall infra.

sam.h: ack — I'm on it. I'm seeing the same spike in 5xx (generation) and TCP retransmits from srv-az3 spine pods. Starting quick triage.

jess: grabbing fabric logs now. spine-2 shows intermittent RX errors on eth2. Suspect intermittent NIC degradation on that rack's top-of-rack. Not seeing full fabric loss though.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: page escalation to infra-leads (step 2) sent.

rafael: joining. Quick mitigation: we should enable region routing degrade to avoid full failover which would thrash KV cache. Plan: mark az3 as degraded for routable traffic, route new sessions to az1/az2, keep existing sessions sticky for a short TTL.

carol: customer-impact note — increasing 502s for customers pinned to az3. Top affected tenants: acme-co, betaapp. Support update drafted.

jess: executing reroute now:
```
# enable degraded routing for az3 (external traffic only)
redwoodctl routing set --region az3 --policy degraded --scope external --reason "nic packet loss"
```

sam.h: rolling restart of network-agent on affected hosts to clear NIC state (srv-az3-001..004):
```
for host in srv-az3-00{1..4}; do ssh $host sudo systemctl restart redwood-network-agent; done
```
Logs:
```
[2026-03-14T22:00:12Z] network-agent[srv-az3-002]: NIC eth2 recovered link flaps -> up
[2026-03-14T22:00:18Z] proxy[srv-az3-002]: active connections drained: 78
```

rafael: KV cache eviction spike observed during earlier failover attempts. Switched cache warming off to avoid cascade. Monitoring queue depth.

oncall-engr: handoff note — I'll need a short doc for night oncall. @david will cover in 15m. Please summarize any remaining actions.

david: ack — I'll take over in 10. Current state: degraded routing active, customer 502s dropped from 15% -> 3% after reroute, internal queue length still elevated but trending down. Any residual manual steps?

carol: sales & CSMs notified; we're preparing targeted messages for affected tenants. Created INC-24683 on the tracker with initial timeline.

sam.h: assigning postmortem - INC-24683-PM. Action items: collect NIC metrics, fabric logs, routing decision log, and runbook gaps. ETA initial timeline in 2 hours.

incident-bot: Automated reminder scheduled: in 10m check for regression and verify routing policy rollback conditions.

jess: leaving notes: if we see recurrent eth2 errors on spine-2 after restart, escalate to hardware ops for NIC replacement. Tagging hosts: hw-ticket-789.

david: taking point. I'll keep the channel updated. If anyone notices customer impact tick up, please ping @pagerduty and call me.

incident-bot: thread closed for now — paging escalations suspended. Manual follow-ups continue.
